title: install-local re-install or upgrade does not withdraw items the new version no longer ships — a dropped tool/flow stays registered and keeps its bare name until restart
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw6yXcLi9aRRBpPT4W

QA-source: #33048 · platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal · observed beside the clauses

## Reproduction (main @ ee9ad834, scratch showcase copy, `os dev --no-compile` on a file DB; reproduced 2×)
1. `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` with package `com.qa.tool-1` 1.0.0 declaring tool `qa_shared_tool` → 200.
2. Re-install `com.qa.tool-1` 1.0.0, then 1.0.1, each with `tools: []` → 200 each.
3. `GET /api/v1/meta/tool/qa_shared_tool` still serves it, `_packageId: com.qa.tool-1`.
4. Install `com.qa.tool-2` declaring `qa_shared_tool` → 422 `PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED` "already held by package com.qa.tool-1".
5. The same with a flow: install `com.qa.addr-b` with flow `qa_sync`, re-install without it → 200, but `GET /api/v1/meta/flow/qa_sync?package=com.qa.addr-b` still serves "QA Sync (B)" and the package-less read still answers 409 naming addr-b.
6. After a restart the dropped items are gone.

Expected: an upgrade/re-install withdraws what the new manifest no longer declares, so its name is free immediately.

Mechanism hint: the registry log shows "Overwriting flow" only for items still present; nothing unregisters the dropped ones on the hot path.
